site.name: booking
site.summary: booking-clone Clone of the Booking.com hotel booking funnel (home → city list → area filters → detail → room → booking → confirmation), plus other business-line and supporting pages. Pages | File | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `index.html` | Home: search bar (destination / check-in & out dates / guests), recommended destinations, recent searches, Genius membership prompt, business-line entries in the footer | | `tokyo.html` | Tokyo hotel list: left filter panel (price, stars, rating, amenities, area), right-hand hotel cards (price, rating, review count, distance, free-cancellation tag), sort bar, map entry | | `shinjuku.html` | Shinjuku-area hotel list, same structure as above, pre-filtered to Shinjuku |

run_plan.goal: Explore and critique the UX of the full booking system, prioritizing the primary checkout/booking flow (home → city list → area filters → detail → room → booking → confirmation) plus adjacent pages, states, and recovery paths.
run_plan.summary: The exploration will proceed in phases: starting with the home page to validate the search flow, then moving to city/area lists to test filtering, followed by hotel detail and room selection, then booking and confirmation. Adjacent flows (flights, car rentals, attractions) will be sampled, and mobile viewport checks will repeat critical interactions.
assumptions: The primary booking flow (home → tokyo.html → shinjuku.html → hotel-detail.html → room-selection.html → reservation.html → confirmation.html) is fully navigable and representative of the system's UX.
risk_hotspots: Small tap targets (e.g., top navigation links) may cause usability issues on mobile. Forms (e.g., reservation details) may have validation or accessibility gaps.

phases.title: Home Page & Search Flow
phases.objective: Validate the home page's search functionality, navigation, and responsive layout (desktop/mobile).
key_checks: Interact with the search bar (destination, dates, guests) and click 'Search' to ensure it navigates to tokyo.html. Test top navigation links (Stays, Flights, etc.) for responsiveness. Check mobile viewport for small tap targets and layout consistency.
exit_criteria: Successfully navigate from index.html to tokyo.html via search. Confirm all top navigation links are clickable and responsive. Mobile viewport shows no critical layout errors.

phases.title: City/Area Hotel Lists
phases.objective: Test filtering, sorting, and navigation on tokyo.html (Tokyo list) and shinjuku.html (Shinjuku list).
key_checks: Interact with filters (price, stars, amenities) and sorting options. Click a hotel card to navigate to hotel-detail.html. Test 'Show on map' and other list features. Repeat critical interactions in mobile viewport.
exit_criteria: Successfully filter/sort results and navigate to a hotel detail page. Confirm map and list features are functional. Mobile viewport filters/sorting work as expected.

phases.title: Hotel Detail & Room Selection
phases.objective: Validate hotel detail page (hotel-detail.html) content, 'Reserve' flow, and room selection (room-selection.html).
key_checks: Review hotel details (location, amenities, reviews). Click 'Reserve' to proceed to room selection. Verify room details, price breakdown, and 'Continue to booking details' button. Check mobile viewport for responsive design.
exit_criteria: Successfully navigate from hotel-detail.html to room-selection.html. Confirm room details and price summary are accurate. Mobile viewport shows readable content and functional buttons.

phases.title: Booking & Confirmation
phases.objective: Test the reservation form (reservation.html) and confirmation page (confirmation.html) for usability, validation, and accessibility.
key_checks: Fill out reservation details (name, email, phone) and submit to reach confirmation.html. Verify confirmation page content (booking details, price, policies). Check form validation (e.g., required fields, email format). Test mobile viewport for form usability.
exit_criteria: Successfully submit reservation and reach confirmation.html. Confirm booking details are accurate. Mobile form interactions are smooth with proper validation.

phases.title: Adjacent Business Flows
phases.objective: Sample adjacent flows (Flights, Car Rentals, Attractions) to assess consistency and usability.
key_checks: Interact with search forms on each page (e.g., flight search, car rental search). Test primary actions (e.g., 'Search' for flights, 'View deal' for car rentals). Check responsive layout and mobile usability.
exit_criteria: Successfully complete a search action on each adjacent page. Confirm layout and functionality are consistent with the primary booking flow. Mobile viewport interactions are error-free.

phases.title: Recovery & Support Paths
phases.objective: Test recovery paths (e.g., 'Cancel booking', 'Manage your trips') and support pages (help.html, my-trips.html).
key_checks: From confirmation.html, test 'Cancel booking' and 'Manage your booking' links. Navigate to my-trips.html to view bookings. Test help.html search and FAQ navigation. Check mobile responsiveness for support actions.
exit_criteria: Successfully navigate recovery paths (e.g., cancel a booking, manage trips). Confirm help page functionality (search, FAQ access). Mobile viewport support actions are usable.

coverage_targets.pages: Visit all known HTML pages (index, tokyo, shinjuku, hotel-detail, room-selection, reservation, confirmation, flights, car-rentals, attractions, help, my-trips).
coverage_targets.features: Exercise most visible controls (search, filters, forms, navigation links) per key page. Test primary actions (search, reserve, book, confirm) and recovery actions (cancel, manage).
coverage_targets.mobile: Repeat critical checks (search, form interactions, navigation) on mobile viewport for all key pages (index, tokyo, hotel-detail, reservation, confirmation).

notes: Max steps (80) should be sufficient to cover all phases, but prioritize the primary booking flow if time is limited. Document any console/network errors or layout warnings encountered during interactions.

observation.visible_text: Booking.com Stays Flights Car rentals Attractions Airport taxis JPY List your property Sign in Home > Japan > Tokyo > Shinjuku > Park Hyatt Tokyo ← Back to results ★★★★★ Park Hyatt Tokyo 📍 3-7-1-2 Nishi Shinjuku, Shinjuku, Tokyo, 163-1055, Japan · Excellent location — rated 9.6/10 🏯 🛌 🍵 🏊 🌄 About Park Hyatt Tokyo Occupying the top 14 floors of the 52-story Shinjuku Park Tower, Park Hyatt Tokyo offers panoramic views of the city skyline and Mount Fuji. The hotel features the renowned New York Grill restaurant, a 20-meter indoor swimming pool, and the Club on the Park fitness center with a stunning view of the city. Each room is spacious and elegantly designed with floor-to-ceiling windows, deep soaking tubs, and original artwork. The hotel is located in the Nishi-Shinjuku business district, a 12-minute walk from Shinjuku Station. Guests can enjoy the Girandole restaurant for all-day dining, the Peak Bar for cocktails with a view, and the Kozue restaurant for authentic Japanese cuisine. The spa offers a range of treatments in a serene setting on the 45th floor. observation.title: Park Hyatt Tokyo - Booking.com
observation.visible_text: Booking.com Stays Flights Car rentals Attractions Airport taxis JPY List your property Sign in Home > Japan > Tokyo > Shinjuku > Park Hyatt Tokyo ← Back to results ★★★★★ Park Hyatt Tokyo 📍 3-7-1-2 Nishi Shinjuku, Shinjuku, Tokyo, 163-1055, Japan · Excellent location — rated 9.6/10 🏯 🛌 🍵 🏊 🌄 About Park Hyatt Tokyo Occupying the top 14 floors of the 52-story Shinjuku Park Tower, Park Hyatt Tokyo offers panoramic views of the city skyline and Mount Fuji. The hotel features the renowned New York Grill restaurant, a 20-meter indoor swimming pool, and the Club on the Park fitness center with a stunning view of the city. Each room is spacious and elegantly designed with floor-to-ceiling windows, deep soaking tubs, and original artwork. The hotel is located in the Nishi-Shinjuku business district, a 12-minute walk from Shinjuku Station. Guests can enjoy the Girandole restaurant for all-day dining, the Peak Bar for cocktails with a view, and the Kozue restaurant for authentic Japanese cuisine. The spa offers a range of treatments in a serene setting on the 45th floor. Each room is thoughtfully designed with comfortable bedding, free WiFi, and modern amenities. The hotel is surrounded by restaurants, convenience stores, and is within walking distance of Kabukicho entertainment district and Shinjuku Gyoen National Garden. Guests can enjoy the on-site restaurant serving Japanese and international cuisine, relax at the rooftop terrace, and explore the many attractions nearby including Meiji Shrine and Takeshita Street in Harajuku. observation.title: Park Hyatt Tokyo - Guest Reviews - Booking.com
observation.visible_text: Booking.com Stays Flights Car rentals Attractions JPY Sign in Home > Tokyo > Park Hyatt Tokyo > Guest reviews Guest reviews Park Hyatt Tokyo 9.4 Exceptional 3,847 reviews Staff 9.6 Facilities 9.4 Cleanliness 9.6 Comfort 9.5 Value for money 8.8 Location 9.6 Free WiFi 9.2 Breakfast 9.3 All reviews (3,847) Most relevant Most recent Highest score Lowest score All Couples (1,234) Families (876) Solo travellers (543) Business (1,194) TK Takeshi Japan · Couple · Deluxe King Room · 3 nights 10 Absolutely perfect in every way 👍 Liked The views from the 47th floor were breathtaking. Staff remembered our names from the first interaction. The New York Grill breakfast is worth every yen. Pool area is serene and never crowded. 👎 Disliked Nothing to complain about. Perhaps the walk from Shinjuku station is a bit long in summer heat, but the hotel shuttle solves that. Reviewed: June 2025 SM Sarah M. United States · Solo traveller · Park King Room · 5 nights 9.6 Lost in Translation vibes, but better 👍 Liked The atmosphere is exactly what you'd hope for. The library lounge is perfect for quiet afternoons. Girandole breakfast buffet has incredible variety. The bed is the most comfortable I've ever slept in. 👎 Disliked Price is steep, but you get what you pay for. The gym can get busy in the early morning. Reviewed: May 2025 LW Li Wei China · Family · Deluxe Twin Room · 4 nights 9.2 Excellent for families with older children 👍 Liked Spacious rooms, impeccable service. The concierge helped us plan our entire Tokyo itinerary. Kids loved the pool. Location is quiet but still accessible to everything. 👎 Disliked Not many kid-specific amenities. The restaurant dress code made dinner with teenagers a bit formal. Would appreciate a kids' menu. Reviewed: April 2025 JB James B. United Kingdom · Business · Park Suite · 2 nights 9.8 The gold standard for business travel 👍 Liked The suite is extraordinary — separate living area, stunning views, and the bathroom alone is larger than most Tokyo hotel rooms. Club lounge access made early mornings productive. Flawless check-in process. 👎 Disliked Honestly nothing. If I had to nitpick, the in-room coffee machine could be upgraded to a proper espresso machine at this price point. Reviewed: March 2025 YK Yuki K. Japan · Couple · Deluxe King Room · 1 night 8.8 Anniversary celebration done right 👍 Liked They arranged a beautiful cake and champagne for our anniversary without us asking — the concierge noticed it in our booking notes. The Peak Bar at sunset is magical. 👎 Disliked For a one-night stay, the value proposition is harder to justify. The minibar prices are quite high even by luxury hotel standards. observation.title: Park Hyatt Tokyo - Booking.com
observation.visible_text: Booking.com Stays Flights Car rentals Attractions Airport taxis JPY List your property Sign in Home > Japan > Tokyo > Shinjuku > Park Hyatt Tokyo ← Back to results ★★★★★ Park Hyatt Tokyo 📍 3-7-1-2 Nishi Shinjuku, Shinjuku, Tokyo, 163-1055, Japan · Excellent location — rated 9.6/10 🏯 🛌 🍵 🏊 🌄 About Park Hyatt Tokyo Occupying the top 14 floors of the 52-story Shinjuku Park Tower, Park Hyatt Tokyo offers panoramic views of the city skyline and Mount Fuji. The hotel features the renowned New York Grill restaurant, a 20-meter indoor swimming pool, and the Club on the Park fitness center with a stunning view of the city. Each room is spacious and elegantly designed with floor-to-ceiling windows, deep soaking tubs, and original artwork. The hotel is located in the Nishi-Shinjuku business district, a 12-minute walk from Shinjuku Station. Guests can enjoy the Girandole restaurant for all-day dining, the Peak Bar for cocktails with a view, and the Kozue restaurant for authentic Japanese cuisine. The spa offers a range of treatments in a serene setting on the 45th floor. The hotel features the renowned New York Grill restaurant, a 20-meter indoor swimming pool, and the Club on the Park fitness center with a stunning view of the city. Each room is spacious and elegantly designed with floor-to-ceiling windows, deep soaking tubs, and original artwork. The hotel is located in the Nishi-Shinjuku business district, a 12-minute walk from Shinjuku Station. Guests can enjoy the Girandole restaurant for all-day dining, the Peak Bar for cocktails with a view, and the Kozue restaurant for authentic Japanese cuisine. The spa offers a range of treatments in a serene setting on the 45th floor.
